questions.question_text: A dataset has heights ranging from $150$ cm to $184$ cm. Which axis scale is most sensible for a scatter plot of this data?

options.text: Start at $145$ cm and use steps of $5$ cm.
Start at $0$ cm and use steps of $50$ cm.
options.why: Starts far from the data, so the whole range of heights is squeezed into less than one grid square.

options.text: Start at $150$ cm and use steps of $1$ cm.
options.why: Uses a step far finer than the data needs, making the axis impractically long.

options.text: Start at $0$ cm and use steps of $200$ cm.
options.why: Uses a step so coarse that all the data would land inside a single interval.

questions.solution_text:
The heights range from $150$ cm to $184$ cm, a span of only $34$ cm.
